newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian Pacific adds grain hopper cars.
newsitem.headline: Canadian Pacific adds grain hopper cars.

text.p: CP Rail System said on Tuesday it will add 1,300 grain hopper cars in the next seven days to expand its Prairie fleet to 13,300 cars.
"Since late spring, our operations and marketing people have been working on plans to meet what was being projected as a good to record year," CP Rail vice-president Rick Sallee said in a statement.
The Canadian Wheat Board on September 12 forecast Prairie grain and oilseed production to reach a record 52.8 million tonnes.
The additional hoppers cars will be in place in the next seven days.
The cars came from other regions of CP's operations or are being leased from other firms, CP spokesman Steve Morris said.
CP's average turnaround--or cycle--time per hopper car loaded on the Prairies for West Coast delivery during peak shipping season is 16 days, Morris said.
Canadian National Railway Co president Paul Tellier told reporters in Winnipeg Tuesday his firm would not add hopper cars to its 14,400-hopper car fleet.
CN's cycle time on hopper cars loaded in Manitoba is 10 days, Tellier said Tuesday.
